name: weed-harness
description: Codex packaging for the shared loop runtime every weed loop plugin builds on: loop-report (the live progress page and its Orca delivery), interview-report and autocode-board (the loops' page views), model-routing (the shared model/effort tier table), and loop-gates (unlazy-backed completion discipline). Required by matt-loop and auto-loop.

interface.shortDescription: Shared runtime for long-running delegated loops: progress page, model routing, completion gates
interface.longDescription: Install weed-harness in Codex to get the layer matt-loop and auto-loop share: loop-report builds and delivers a live progress page for a delegated run (Orca artifact link, or the Orca browser tab when links are unavailable), model-routing is the one table of model/effort tiers every loop routes through, and loop-gates is the convention for turning 'done' into a re-verified unlazy ledger. The Claude Code-only setup skill (statusLine HUD, hooks) is not part of the Codex package.
